stops.name: Creek Metro Station, Al Jaddaf
stops.rider_instructions: Wait at the forecourt of Creek Metro Station. Be here 5 minutes before your time and look for the yellow M sign in the bus windscreen.
stops.driver_instructions: Station forecourt lay-by. Height clear.

stops.name: Oud Metha Metro Station
stops.rider_instructions: Wait at the bus stop on the Oud Metha Rd side of the metro. Be here 5 minutes before your time and look for the yellow M sign in the bus windscreen.
stops.driver_instructions: Use the bus stop on the Oud Metha Rd side. RTA stop: 2 minutes maximum.

stops.name: BurJuman Mall
stops.where_exactly: Khalid Bin Al Waleed Rd entrance.
stops.rider_instructions: Wait at the Khalid Bin Al Waleed Rd entrance of BurJuman. Be here 5 minutes before your time and look for the yellow M sign in the bus windscreen.
stops.driver_instructions: Use the Khalid Bin Al Waleed Rd entrance, kerbside. Do not enter the mall car park. Busy at 06:20, keep it brief.

stops.name: Raffa 1 bus stop, Khalid Bin Al Waleed Rd, Bur Dubai

stops.name: New Gold Souq, Al Raffa, Bur Dubai

stops.driver_instructions: Kerbside on Al Raffa St outside the New Gold Souq building; pull in clear of the taxi rank, do not enter the side streets. Only served on booked days.

stops.name: Al Wasl Building, Al Hudaiba

stops.driver_instructions: Kerbside on 4B St outside Al Wasl Building Block A. Side street, Hiace only; Rosa on Wednesdays should stop on the main road corner instead.

stops.driver_instructions: Use the bus stop on the Trade Centre side of Sheikh Zayed Rd. RTA stop: 2 minutes maximum.

stops.driver_instructions: Use the bus stop at the DIFC side exit. RTA stop: 2 minutes maximum.

stops.driver_instructions: Kerbside on Financial Center Rd upper level outside the main entrance. Do not enter the tower drop-off (low canopy). Only served on booked days.

stops.driver_instructions: Al A'amal St entrance, kerbside. Do not enter the Bay Avenue car park (low roof).

stops.driver_instructions: Kerbside on Marasi Drive outside Ubora Residence Tower. Do not enter the tower drop-off or car park. Only served on booked days.

stops.name: Bay Square, Business Bay

stops.driver_instructions: Building 1 entrance, kerbside on the ring road. Do not enter the podium.

stops.driver_instructions: Main entrance forecourt. Stop short of the canopy, kerbside.

stops.driver_instructions: Meydan Heights villas gate, Nad Al Sheba 1, off Al Ain Rd. Pull in clear of the barrier; do not enter the compound. Only served on booked days.
